title: Parent curation of Fable concepts
status: Design proposals only; original staged plan remains unchanged

accepted_for_visual_exploration.reason: A genuinely new relationship between wallpaper and widget; composition centered around the landscape instead of another card layout.
accepted_for_visual_exploration.scope: Prepared background/foreground asset pairs first. Prototype fit and scale alignment before promising live wallpaper depth.

accepted_for_visual_exploration.reason: Tests whether the layout model supports a different orientation and makes useful use of vertical space.
accepted_for_visual_exploration.scope: Standard vertical COSMIC panel with native applets. No promise of vertical Islands support; stacked clock stays outside the narrow panel.
accepted_for_visual_exploration.confidence: Native panel direction is grounded; final applet and scaling acceptance still required.

accepted_for_visual_exploration.reason: A setup can retain its identity through the day; the timeline makes inherited overrides visible.
accepted_for_visual_exploration.scope: Optional scheduled visual overrides. Begin with day/night and fixed times; sun times later. Define manual override, schedule conflict and session precedence before implementation.
accepted_for_visual_exploration.stage: After shared style model, during editor stage
accepted_for_visual_exploration.confidence: Reuses scheduling, but needs a new bounded override/resolution model.

accepted_for_visual_exploration.reason: Makes selective domains understandable and supports the way users borrow a layout from one setup and a style from another.
accepted_for_visual_exploration.scope: Local library and personal picture first. Show merge differences and readable fallbacks; preserve content/accounts; sharing lineage later.
accepted_for_visual_exploration.stage: Editor stage; local composer can precede a full widget builder
accepted_for_visual_exploration.confidence: Good fit with existing selective-domain planning; cross-domain consistency still needs implementation.

accepted_for_visual_exploration.reason: Typography is visible before choosing, rather than hidden behind a list of font names.
accepted_for_visual_exploration.scope: Installed families/styles, bounded preview tiles, stable digit width and type size. Variable axes only where actual renderer support is verified.
accepted_for_visual_exploration.confidence: Strong early-value UI; named font samples in generated imagery are illustrative.

additional_useful_proposals.decision: Small built-in day-timeline face; show in Ridge concept. Calendar/focus event clustering needs design.

Prioritize real-rendered share images plus existing file export before building a hosted gallery. User controls whether personal wallpaper appears; distinguish share preview from exported private data.
Optional artwork-derived music tint; bounded/event-driven and local to the music surface. Existing colour-follow policy must define precedence.
Matte/no-surface first, subtle texture finishes later; maintain readability at all scale factors.
Manual 'Fit to picture' suggestions worth prototyping, but local variance alone cannot understand faces/subjects or aesthetic importance; no automatic moves on wallpaper change.

deferred.reason: Focus/meeting-driven rearrangement can fight manual edits and change layout unexpectedly. Keep opt-in, explicit active-state editing and reliable restore; do not delay base styling.

Timed live trials are more complex than Fable's 'low' estimate. Need crash-safe revert, conflict handling, native job completion and defined domains; cannot assume Undo guarantees restoration after other changes.
Not necessary for initial layered assets; separate resource/quality problem.
Do not infer support from native panel Left/Right anchors; qualify companion independently.

plan_recommendations: Narrow first milestone to shared styling plus clock typography/faces and two coherent real presets; keep existing setup/import/Undo behavior.
Do not require the general widget builder before shipping better built-in widgets.
Keep content access close to the inspector, but reuse existing account/content pages instead of duplicating their workflows.
Make no-surface a first-class styling option and test center/vertical compositions before fixing layout assumptions.
Define setup override precedence now, but do not implement every future time/activity layer in the first release.
Accessibility constraints take precedence over a setup's visual preferences; previews must show the resulting adjusted design.
images: Generated with the built-in image_gen tool; future concepts, not actual application captures.
scope_boundary: Original visual exploration only; later architecture-first sequencing is tracked in the parent folder.
archive_notice: Historical proposal. Current architecture and sequencing are in ../../ARCHITECTURE.md, ../../ROADMAP.md and ../../tracker.json.
